title: The bait mode's last wave before the friends' playtest (wave B): fear per gun, a temperament with lunges, Isao's chatter director and the NUKE CLEAR cue
context: Owner, 2026-10-09: (a) "we want more granularity to tweak how it reacts to impacts, we want 'fear'... #2 or #3 hits gets it wild temporarily, hurrying away from the impact; desired behavior: the user learns that he can place strikes to separate the predator from Isao, and create an opportunity for a clean nuke. #1 registers a little as a barrage, #2 a lot." (b) "chase speed we need basic speed and a measure of sudden accelerations once in a while, the threatening look comes from the tentacles lengthening/reaching, and from sudden bursts of speed." (c) "Isao is too verbose with the three lines about elevation. reduce the frequency ... and add more diversity", with seven new recorded lines (commit 3b4b9ec3). Coordinator's wave B on refactor-run (not pushed), after 2026-10-09-boss-bait-wave-a-playtest-fixes. Bait mode only; the tank mode's fear is unchanged.
outcome: (1) FEAR PER GUN (src/domain/boss-fear.js `barrage`, `scare`, `flightNow`, `meterNow`; numbers BOSS_FIGHT.gunFear; lab src/labs/boss/fear.js). Within reach of a floor contact or any body node: each 25 mm round adds 0.06 to a barrage meter drained 0.5 a second; at 1 a flinch (flee point 10 m ahead, 0.8 s, x1.3 the base chase speed), the meter reset, the kit disturbed (its crouch is the flinch); 23 rounds of a 30 a second barrage tip it. The 40 mm: wild (35 m, 2.5 s, x2, erratic +2). The MK-9: panic (50 m, 3.5 s, x2.5, erratic +1), and the bait mode's own `nuke stun (s)` (0; the tank mode keeps 1.5). One flight at a time: a fresh hit extends it to its own end when later and re-aims it from the newest impact; a stronger level takes the flight over, a weaker keeps its numbers. The flee point is `flee` metres ahead of the centre straight away from the impact (as the tank mode's `fear flee`). Wild and panic do not disturb the kit (its recoil would hold the body still for half a second of the flight). Panel folder `fear per gun (bait)`, copy-block line `gun fear:`. (2) TEMPERAMENT (src/domain/boss-temperament.js, lab src/labs/boss/temperament.js): one layer writes the kit's live speed, reach duration, pause, stretch, spread and erratic each frame in the bait mode from the BASE (the panel's motion knobs; the predator's chase speed is now 1.2): lunges every 3-8 s (start to start, seeded by the round), 0.6-1.2 s at chase speed 3 with the reach duration, stretch and spread x1.5 within the kit's ranges (stretch stays at its 5, spread reaches 6), eased over 0.2 s; a due lunge waits for the kit's pursuit to be in its pull, the only phase where the chase speed moves the body. The fear's flight writes through the same layer and wins (a running lunge ends, a due one is skipped): speed x the flight's factor, the reach duration and the pause divided by it (the surges come that much more often), erratic up; both ease back to the base. Folder `temperament (bait)` (base speed, lunges, lunge speed, every min/max, duration min/max, reach boost), copy line `temperament:`. (3) CHATTER DIRECTOR (src/domain/boss-chatter.js, numbers BOSS_FIGHT.chatter, lab src/labs/boss/chatter.js): one line at a time at least 6 s apart, the highest priority wanted first (death and not today 10, nuke in his face 8, help and close call 7, hurt and stagger 6, careful with the nuke 5, use the 40 and barrage 4, taunt 3, the fly-over 1), per-line cooldowns, a round's counts, stale wants dropped (ttl), the fly-over asked on one hop in three (seeded) and never the same take twice running, `not today` wanted 2 s after `death` (so said at the gap, 6 s). Triggers (src/labs/boss/bait.js, numbers chatter.triggers): close call (a landing within 6 m outside his ring, or an escape from an arm that came within 5 m), help (trapped for half the trap time, or an escape from under the creature), barrage (a body node within 25 m and no player fire for 5 s), stagger (the round's first 40 mm fright), use the 40 (no 40 mm for 20 s with a node within 30 m), careful with the nuke (the MK-9 selected, or aimed with him inside its 55 m ring), nuke in his face (an MK-9 within 70 m he survives); hurt, taunt, death and not today keep their triggers. Lines play through the game's Isao voice (all twelve recorded), the caption the fallback. The seat reports the player's fire (`gunner()`). (4) NUKE CLEAR: at the end of Isao's HUD row, lit beyond 55 + 8 m of the creature's centre, grey inside. (5) `bait.flee` 32 m/s (24). BROWSER (--boss-bait, from a snapshot): the 40 mm led between the creature and Isao sent it wild, away from the impact (mean cosine 0.83 and 0.86; 74.6 m carried away), its kit speed averaging 35.5 and 38.9 m/s against a base mean of 16.4 and 16.7, above 1.5 times the base for 1.2 and 1.64 s of the 2.4-2.9 s flight (bound 1 s: the margin is thin); a 25 mm barrage on the centre tipped the meter in 2.95 s of lab clock; 60 s of chatter said 10 lines, 8 distinct, the closest two 6.01 s apart; NUKE CLEAR lit at 83.6 m, grey at 8.7 m. THE ESCAPES FROM UNDER (the `--boss-under` probe, 30 s on the defaults, the random fly-over off): before 0.61, 0.64, 0.62; after 0.58, 0.82, 0.85, 0.56 (and 0.54, 0.56 in the suite's 10 s gap run); lunges off 0.69, reach sweep 1 0.73. Not under 50 per cent: every escape is the arms rule (two floor contacts within 15 m on opposite sides of him), 3 to 5 escapes in 30 s, each 3.5 to 7 s long (a full climb to 30 m and a cross to beyond the arms' envelope); the chase speed is not the cause (the creature's centre runs the same with base 1.2 as with 3). Wave A's 30-57 m/s 'lunge' figures came from poll-to-poll displacement in the lab's re-anchoring frame; measured from the bound's centre it is noisier still (p90 26-46 m/s, maxima to 137), while the kit's own velocity reads a mean of 8.5 to 17 m/s, so those tails are not the creature's pace. The owner's levers for the share: the under rule's 15 m or its opposite-sides test, a shorter escape (land at the nearest clear point rather than beyond the whole envelope), or the arms' sweep and spread.
alternatives: A fixed flee goal at the hit (rejected: the kit slows to a third within 16 m of its target, so a 10 m flinch would barely move; the point runs ahead as the tank mode's does)
Disturbing the kit on every scare (rejected for wild and panic: the recoil holds it still 0.55 s of a 2.5 s flight; kept for the flinch, where the crouch reads as one)
Lunges on a free clock (rejected: the chase speed only acts in the kit's pull phase, so a lunge in a reach would show no burst; a due lunge waits for the pull)
Letting not today follow death after 2 s (rejected: the director's 6 s gap is global; it follows at the gap)
evidence: node test/boss-gun-fear.mjs, test/boss-temperament.mjs, test/boss-chatter.mjs (new), test/boss-bait.mjs (the recorded smooth run replayed at its flee of 24), test/boss-settings-copy.mjs, test/nih-dairia-content.mjs; npm test (224 programs), npm run check, npm run build

from an APFS snapshot, sequentially (memory WARN on swap, one headless Chrome): --boss-bait (with boss-bait-friends: labs.html?playtest=1&mode=bait#boss loads with no errors), --boss, --boss-cam, --boss-fight green; --boss-under on the tree before and after (scripts/browser-test.mjs, new flag)

suite changes: the predator's base 1.2 and the copy's two new lines asserted; the earlier pursuit runs with the lunges off; the aimed runs and kills with the fear off (the fight's flow is under test); the fly-over's line asserted said or held by the director's gap; the flight's top speed allows the slew down from the 32 m/s flee
